中文說明 Online Reservation
今日抽籤日期 : 2026-11-07 ~ 2026-12-02

今日開放山屋及營地申請日期為 2026-11-07 至2027-01-02 (即日起第5天至2個月)。

  • 可組隊申請每隊人數1〜12名，同天住宿日內不得同時申請山屋或營地。
  • 申請人務必為領隊及入住人員。有關申請相關資訊(如繳款、床位等)僅有申請人可取得，申請人綁定為領隊。
  • 申請系統將於住宿日前30日下午3點進行床位及營位抽籤，下午3點30分公佈，如有連續申請住宿，系統將於最後住宿抽籤日公布網站上，未抽中床位及營位申請單將列入候補(候補名單無順序)。
  • 住宿日前5日至29日之期間，系統每日下午3點將針對空餘床位及營位進行抽籤，並將抽籤結果於網站上公布。
  • 入住隊伍經申請後，不得增加入住人數，如欲增加須取消訂單已重新申請方式辦理。
  • 抽中訂單將以簡訊及EMAIL通知，繳款帳號可至訂單繳款資訊內查詢，未抽中訂單會自動列入候補不另行通知。
  • 申請單抽中未繳款前最多減少2員，請至編輯內修改刪除，人員減少後將產生新的繳款帳號可至繳款資訊內查詢，系統不另行通知
  • 繳款完成後訂單會自動變更成已收款，系統不另行通知，臨櫃繳款者請於次日後查詢。
  • 上山日攜帶證件供登山口人員或山莊管理員查詢核對後即會告知床位或營位號。
  • 申請進入北大武山國家步道從事登山活動之民眾，其餐飲、營帳、睡袋、個人健康需要之氧氣瓶及醫藥用品等，均由民眾自備
  • 訂單抽中後，只能更換領隊，禁止更換入住人員
  • 訂房前請詳閱「申請規則」說明
  • 若因修繕或公務暫停住宿之訊息請詳「最新消息 」
  • 申請山屋（營地）請點選日期，進行訂屋流程。
請加入「國家災害防救科技中心」LINE官方帳號，並訂閱屏東縣之颱風、降雨等即時防災資訊(亦可全部訂閱)。本山屋及步道於颱風警報期間及降雨達豪雨標準(24小時內200mm或3小時內100mm)時將暫停開放。
依教育部訂定之「登山活動應注意事項」第5點，登山者自行從事登山活動時，應本於風險自我承擔，投保適當之保險。登山服務業者、職業登山嚮導、登山團體或其他登山活動之主辦單位，應協助有意願投保相關保險之登山者及相關人員投保適當之保險。
信用卡退刷期限已由原60日延長至90日，籲請民眾如有取消行程需求，務請自行掌控時程，以避免影響自身權益。

 

 
【守護山林】請加入「山老鼠雷達站」LINE森林盜伐通報平台，或撥打森林保護專線：0800-000-930（您您您，救山林），林業及自然保育署將依檢舉竊取森林主副產物破案獎金核發檢舉獎金。

 

禁止事項：依森林法第34條規定，森林區域及森林保護區內，不得有引火行為，如引火整地、營火、烤肉等，違者依同條第56條規定處新台幣十二萬元 以上六十萬元以下罰鍰。
檢舉盜伐、通報森林火災，保林專線電話：0800-000930、0800-057930

 

Applications for cabins and campsites are open from $start to $end (5 days to 2 months from now).

  • People can apply in groups. Beds can be reserved for 1 to 12 people per group, and campsites can be reserved for 1 to 4 people per group. Each group can apply for a maximum of 3 campsites.
  • The applicant must be the group leader and a member of the group staying. Application-related information (such as payment, bed availability, etc.) is only available to the applicant, who is bound as the group leader.
  • The application system will draw lots for beds and camping spaces at 3:00 PM on the 30th day before the accommodation date, and the results will be announced at 3:30 PM.If you have applied for accommodation consecutively, the system will announce the final accommodation lottery date on the website. Applications that were not selected for beds or camping spaces will be placed on a waiting list (the waiting list is not ordered).
  • From 5 to 29 days before your arrival date, a lottery will be held daily at 3:00 PM for available beds and camping spots. The results will be announced on the website.
  • Once a team has applied, additional guests are not permitted. To add guests, you must cancel your reservation and reapply.
  • Winning orders will be notified via SMS and email. The payment account number can be found in the order's Payment Information. Unselected orders will be automatically placed on the waiting list without further notice.
  • Up to two members can be removed from the selected application before payment. Please modify or delete them in the edit section. After the number of members is reduced, a new payment account number will be generated and can be found in the Payment Information. The system will not notify you further.
  • Once payment is completed, the order will automatically be changed to Paid. The system will not notify you further. Those who paid at the counter should check the next day or later.
  • On your day of climbing, please bring your ID to the trailhead staff or the lodge administrator for verification. Your bed or campsite number will then be provided.
  • Those applying to enter the Beidawushan National Trail for mountaineering activities are required to provide their own meals, tents, sleeping bags, oxygen cylinders, and medical supplies for personal health needs.
  • Once your reservation is selected, only the tour leader can be changed; changes to the guests are prohibited.
  • Please read the "Application Rules" Instructions
  • For information regarding temporary accommodation suspension due to renovations or official duties, please refer to "Latest News 》
  • To apply for a cabin (campsite), please select a date and proceed with the reservation process.
Please join the National Disaster Prevention and Relief Science and Technology Center's official LINE account and subscribe to Pingtung County's real-time disaster prevention information, including typhoons and rainfall (you can also subscribe to all information). This mountain hut and trails will be closed during typhoon warnings and when rainfall reaches heavy rain standards (200mm in 24 hours or 100mm in 3 hours).
According to Point 5 of the "Precautions for Mountaineering Activities" stipulated by the Ministry of Education, climbers should assume all risks when engaging in mountaineering activities on their own and purchase appropriate insurance. Mountaineering service providers, professional mountain guides, mountaineering groups, and other mountaineering activity organizers should assist climbers and related personnel who wish to purchase appropriate insurance.
The credit card refund period has been extended from 60 days to 90 days. If you need to cancel your trip, please manage your schedule to avoid affecting your rights.
[Protect Our Forests] Please join the "Mountain Mouse Radar Station" LINE illegal logging reporting platform or call the Forest Protection Hotline: 0800-000-930 (You, You, Save Our Forests). The Forestry and Conservation Department will issue a reward for reporting the theft of forest products and byproducts.

Prohibitions: According to Article 34 of the Forest Act, any fire-related activities, such as land preparation, campfires, or barbecues, are prohibited within forest areas and forest reserves. Violators will be fined NT$120,000 to NT$600,000 in accordance with Article 56 of the same Act.
To report illegal logging and forest fires, contact the forest protection hotline: 0800-000930, 0800-057930
